name: 173.4 — a widget names its builder, and the addon layer has a root
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 173.4: widget:addon() and :info().addon name the addon that built a widget and answer nil on the client's own, hafen.ui():root() is the parent of a surface built without :parent(w) and its :match finds one by name, and both verbs refuse an argument.
